tone_hot_tip: Sells the most; credibility drops fast when the proof is thin.
naming_named_tip: Hurts the most, and invites the most retaliation.
naming_alias_tip: It hurts less. The town can guess who it is, and the person may still hold it against you.
naming_anon_tip: The safest, and carries the least weight.

hint: Pick a matter from the notebook. One story per matter, 1 to 4 items.
nothing: Nothing in the notebook is fit to print. Run the issue empty, or wait for next week.
facts_warn: Unconfirmed items can run and sell just as well. Print something wrong, and the town remembers.
soft_note: Public knowledge. Print it straight, no alias needed.
evidence: Attach a copy of the record

confirm_n: Stories in this issue: {n}. Once it goes to press, there is no taking it back.
confirm_empty: Not one story this issue, only ads and notices. Two weeks running without hard news and subscribers will leave. Print it like this?
